english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making an amount or quantity smaller.
This is the all-purpose choice for reducing an amount or making something less.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for reducing an amount or number, rather than specifically reducing physical size or staff.
Use this neutral verb for a quantity decreasing or for deliberately reducing a quantity.
Use this especially for amounts, numbers, frequency, or intensity becoming or being made less.
Use 減少 when an amount, degree, or size is reduced rather than simply falling by itself.
Use transitive 減少 when you make an amount, number, or degree smaller.

examples.english: The company needs to reduce the plastic used in packaging.
examples.traditional: 公司要減少包裝用嘅膠。
